items.statement: Within the isolated-molecule calculation boundary, C1's principal absorption is consistent with a bright, predominantly HOMO-to-LUMO pi-to-pi-star excitation and an LE-like frontier-orbital distribution; this does not establish solvent or aggregate behavior.
